```{js}
$(function() {
  $(".level2").css('visibility', 'hidden');
  $(".level2").first().css('visibility', 'visible');
  $(".container-fluid").height($(".container-fluid").height() + 300);
  $(window).on('scroll', function() {
    $('h2').each(function() {
      var h2Top = $(this).offset().top - $(window).scrollTop();
      var windowHeight = $(window).height();
      if (h2Top >= 0 && h2Top <= windowHeight / 2) {
        $(this).parent('div').css('visibility', 'visible');
      } else if (h2Top > windowHeight / 2) {
        $(this).parent('div').css('visibility', 'hidden');
      }
    });
  });
})
```

## Plot 1:

![](C:/Users/Admin/New%20Zealand/UoA/Academic/STATS%20220/Project%204/plot1.png)

Overall, I mostly walked 4000 - 7000 steps per day that there were 23 days of the range. There was only 2 day that I walk more than 10000 steps.

## Plot 2:

![](C:/Users/Admin/New%20Zealand/UoA/Academic/STATS%20220/Project%204/plot2.png)

On average, I walked 1.98, 3.8, 2.95, 2.9, 2.98, 2.22, 1.9 hours on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday over 4 weeks from 31/03/2026 to 29/04/2026. The boxplot showed that the there are variety of hours I walked in a day which was not consistent. Based on the median, it showed that I tended to walk for longer hours on weekdays than weekend.

## Plot 3:

![](C:/Users/Admin/New%20Zealand/UoA/Academic/STATS%20220/Project%204/plot3.png)

Overall, the activity of going to University was the activity contributing the most to the my step ranges from Monday to Thursday. I have a part-time job on Friday and Sunday, so it contributed the most to my step range. Lastly, Saturday is weekend and I do not have work on that day, I stay at my department most of the time, so staying in my apartment is the activity contributing the most to my step range.
